backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report listing frontend files, components, and tests related to appointment form, validation, and navigation updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing purpose and UI changes of various frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with favicon, metadata, Ahmedabad-focused SEO tags, social previews, and JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component composing the full landing page layout including header, hero, services, appointment form, and footer.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon badge component providing size and color variants using theme classes.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Logo wrapper component applying size-based padding and a decorative backing container.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Floating WhatsApp and call buttons fixed to the bottom-left corner with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/landing/Appointm: Full appointment form with validation, WhatsApp URL generation, and form reset on submit.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays lists of Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar areas with responsive grid styling and icon badge heading.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick links, and contact details including phone, location, and Google profile.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Displays Google reviews section with rating, call-to-action button, and decorative star rating.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Provides a sticky header with logo, navigation links, and quick-access contact buttons for call, WhatsApp, and Instagram.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Shows the main hero banner with background image, service highlights, and buttons to book or call.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Renders a gallery of live cleaning photos with optional labels and responsive card layout.
frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceC: Shows a banner highlighting the service coverage areas with a map-style image.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Defines themed service cards and pricing details for sofa, carpet, chair, mattress, and AC cleaning services.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: A React UI component that lets users choose sofa size in feet and calculates cleaning cost at ₹90 per foot with call and WhatsApp CTAs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, invalidating dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity React context/provider handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/utility setup defining OKLCH theme variables, dark mode palettes, typography tweaks, and accessibility utilities.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappBooking.ts: Utility to format booking details into a WhatsApp-friendly message and generate a prefilled WhatsApp URL.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that mounts React, wrapping the app with React Query and Internet Identity provider setup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, radius, shadows, and plugins using OKLCH variables and service-specific color palettes.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project scope, requirements, architectural notes, and known issues for the sofa cleaning website build.
